verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents natural-language operation of the product in two places: the official RudderStack MCP server, which lets users 'debug delivery errors, monitor pipelines, write and test transformations, review audit logs — all through natural language' from any MCP client, and Rudder AI, an AI-powered agent in Slack for managing and interacting with the workspace. Together these cover the core of operating the product by natural-language command. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the NL operation works as claimed, explicit documentation that connection setup (creating or editing sources and destinations) is covered by natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
